fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: Computer Science and Technology is one of the characteristic majors of Jiangsu province. Provides a strong technical background for students planning to begin careers upon graduation and for those interested in graduate study in computer science. Emphasis is placed on developing both the software programming and hardware design necessary to begin and enhance an individual's career. Graduates of this program are well prepared for immediate employment in either the computer industry or many other businesses that increasingly rely on computer science. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The key courses which will be instructed in the 4 years are listed below. 2.1 Key Courses 2.2 Curriculum Schedule for the CST ofJiangsu University Note: It may change every year, so it is only for reference. Type A Courses Type B Courses Type C Courses Type D Courses Type E Courses 2.3 The Allocation of Credits and course 3. Internship Practice and Graduation Editor Notes: The graduate employment rates has been among the best. The school has several computer laboratories with high class servers where students are practicing during their studies. Also through associations at the university students can connect with companies which can help them conduct an internship. Graduates engage in the computer software and hardware applications, development, research and teaching, etc. in enterprises, government departments, research departments and institutions of higher learning, also can apply for further studies in computer science graduate. 4. Brief Introduction to Jiangsu University(JSU) Editor Notes: JSU ranks 39 among >3000 higher educational institutions in China. Jiangsu University , situated in a beautiful and well-known historic and cultural city on the southern bank of the Yangtze River - Zhenjiang, is a comprehensive teaching-and-research-type university featuring engineering, one of its five chief fields: engineering, medicine, science, management and humanities. Learn More>> 5. About Overseas Education College (OEC) Editor Notes: OEC is responsible for foreign students' admission, academic affairs, routine administration and organizing Chinese international education. OEC has established a scholarship system and is now providing students with scholarships of different types. OEC pays attention to cultural inheritance and therefore organizes foreign students to take part in various activities in and outside university. OEC has always been trying to help foreign students understand Chinese culture and feel the happiness of study in China. 6. Colourful Life Editor Notes: OEC occasionally holds different activities or events which help foreign and Chinese students communicate and build up an internationalized atmosphere on campus. “Chinese Bridge" Competition Dragon Boat Race

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. English language proficiency certificate (non-English speaking countries) Applicants for programs taught in English must provide copies of their IELTS, TOEFL, or Duolingo English Test scores. IELTS scores should be above 6.0, TOEFL scores should be above 80, or Duolingo scores should be above 100. * 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 3. Passport Passport cover and a scanned copy of the passport photo page (valid after September 30, 2026). Applicants with previous experiences in China should provide scans of all documents related to Chinese visas and residence permits. * 4. Senior High school Degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. Senior high school academic transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 6. Foreigner Physical Examination Form: Applicants must undergo a medical examination following the items listed in the form. The examination results are valid for 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Personal Statement A self-statement of intent for studying in China (no less than 800 words), written in English. The content should include personal educational and work experiences, motivations for studying in China, reasons for selecting the specific major, and post-graduation personal development plans. * 8. Valid non-criminal Record Applicants without a non-criminal record certificate may submit proof of good conduct during their time in school (only for current high school graduates). * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details.versity has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. Financial Statement within 6 months Either the family deposit certificate, property certificate or parent/guardian income certificate with a recommended minimum value of $5,000 USD or equivalent. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Applicants should have completed high school or possess equivalent qualifications. They must hold a valid passport. 18 to 25 years old. Applicants under 18 years of age should provide a guaranty from a guardian. Applicants who were previously Chinese citizens and have subsequently acquired foreign nationality shall meet the requirements in the relevant regulations of China's Ministry of Education. English Proficiency (For English-Taught Programs): Applicants for programs taught in English must provide copies of their IELTS, TOEFL, or Duolingo English Test scores. IELTS scores should be above 6.0, TOEFL scores should be above 80, or Duolingo scores should be above 100. CSCA Transcript (Maths, Physics).
